sourceContracts: SkillInstallRequest: skillId, version, publisherId, manifestDigest, requestedCapabilityRefs, catalogEntryRef, expectedCatalogRevision. SkillInstallProposal: proposalId, same immutable digest, policyDecisionRef, reviewState(pending/approved/rejected), evalReportRef?, revocationState. Catalog results bound 1–100 entries, authenticated pagination; no executable marketplace payload.
rows.assertions: signed+revoked+tenant checks; proposal does not install/execute; catalog limit <=100
forged tenant denied; opaque credentials only; model cannot deliver network messages
MCP metadata cannot execute tools; endpoint policy before use; no freeform credentials
use existing A2A checked state mapping; no out-of-order terminal resurrection or duplicate effects
one active scoped assignment per task+version; cancelled/expired parent denies reassignment
report never restores/deletes data; restore evidence includes actual validation and limitations
candidate is not a published fact; provenance/scope preserved; CAS checked at later publication
candidate cannot edit protected evals/sign/promote itself; data storage only

sourceContracts: GraphQuery: permitted scope refs, entityRefs, relationTypes, maxDepth(1–2), limit(1–100), cursor?. GraphResult: scoped observations/relations with sourceRefs, validUntil, revisions, nextCursor. Every traversal hop is tenant/role/private filtered inside existing PostgreSQL observation broker; no new graph database.
rows.assertions: depth1..2/limit1..100; filter every graph hop and scope inheritance; reject cycles beyond depth
protected paths denied; existing working files not touched; promotion separate

sourceContracts: TaskPlan/PlanStep/PlanValidation/StepOutcome use section 5. Canonical planDigest binds goalRevision and ordered validated steps; scheduler accepts only completed predecessor outcomes and never treats unknown as completed.
rows.assertions: reject cycles/duplicate step IDs; goal revision and digest match; parallelism <=8

sourceContracts: CritiqueReport: reportId, goalId, goalRevision, taskResultRef, criticId/version, findings[{claimId, category(unsupported/conflict/error/missing_evidence), evidenceRefs, safeSummary}], suggestedPlanRevision?, usage. At most 32 findings and 2 critique rounds per interactive run within inherited iteration/task caps.
rows.assertions: <=32 findings and <=2 rounds; critic findings do not change approval/policy

sourceContracts: SkillSelectionRequest: taskType, availableSkillRefs, requestedSkillRefs, maxContextTokens, grantRef. QualifiedSkillSelection: sorted skillId/version/digest refs, selectedInstructionRefs, omitted reasons, tokenCount. Selection filters verified/nonrevoked/authorized skills before deterministic ranking; instructions remain distinct from untrusted data.
rows.assertions: verified/nonrevoked/currently authorized filtering before ranking and token budget

sourceContracts: AgentDefinitionCandidate: definitionId, roleId, promptArtifactDigest, modelPolicyRef, skillVersionRefs, toolManifestRefs, requestedCapabilityRefs, memoryPolicyRef, evalSetRef. AgentDefinitionProposal: proposalId, candidateDigest, evalReportRef, policyDecisionRef, lifecycle(staged/denied/review_required), versionRef. Never deploy or issue authority on definition validation alone.
rows.assertions: definition validation cannot grant/deploy; immutable candidate digest

sourceContracts: AgentLifecycleResult: agentId, definitionVersionRef, checkpointRef?, owningRunId?, lifecycle(active/suspended/stopped/revoked/failed), lastTransitionAt, currentGrantRef?, nextScheduleRef?. Persistent agents resume only with current authorization; stop revokes future dispatch and cancels bounded active work.
rows.assertions: reject invalid/stale transitions; stopped/revoked cannot resume without current grant

rows.table: reuse ingress_events; trigger_acceptances if canonical ingress has no required bindings
sourceContracts: TriggerEvent: schemaVersion, eventId, tenantId (derived by trusted adapter), sourceId, externalEventId, occurredAt, receivedAt, bounded payloadRef, signatureVerificationRef. TriggerAcceptance: acceptedId, duplicate boolean, scheduledRunRef?, status(accepted/rejected/rate_limited). Idempotency keys bind tenant/source/externalEventId and validated digest.
rows.assertions: trusted tenant only; same external key+digest dedup; altered digest conflict; bound rate/capacity

rows.table: reuse heartbeat schedules; add schedule_specs for broader contract
sourceContracts: ScheduleSpec: scheduleId, tenantId, owningConversationId, goalRef, timezone(IANA), scheduleExpression, missedRunPolicy(skip/run_once), overlapPolicy(skip/queue_one), notificationIntent, version, budgetRef, grantRef. ScheduleRecord adds nextRunAt, lastRunRef?, enabled, policyDecisionRef. DST gaps/overlaps, deletion and downtime have explicit deterministic fixtures; no arbitrary code in expressions.
rows.assertions: DST/missed-run/overlap policy validated; no arbitrary code; no scheduler execution in model

sourceContracts: ApprovalQuorumRequest: effectRef/inputHash/artifactHash?, policyVersion, proposalVersion, requiredActorRoles, quorumCount, expiresAt, nonceRef. ApprovalQuorumDecision: pending/allowed/denied/expired plus authenticated decisionRefs, exact binding and current epoch. Modification creates a new proposal/version; no client-provided replacement effect args.
rows.assertions: authenticated actors distinct; exact binding and expiry; changed proposal invalidates old decisions

rows.table: reuse identity_grants through PostgresGrantStore and current identity issuer
sourceContracts: ResourceGrantRequest: requested action/resource/audience constraints, expiry, parentGrantRef, delegationDepth. Signed grants bind verified parent lineage, tenant, audience, action and resource selectors; deny unknown/revoked parents, widened selectors and expiry beyond parent. Opaque signing keys remain in identity service.
rows.assertions: use existing issuance/verifier; child subset and audience; no signing key on model object

sourceContracts: ActionPreview: previewId, effectId, inputHash, artifactHash?, simulationReportRef, assumptions, proposedChangesRef, estimatedCostMicroUsd|null, risks, expiresAt, version. Preview uses no-live-effect grants; later execution revalidates current authority and exact reviewed digest.
rows.assertions: no effects during model writes; executable approval requires exact current input/artifact digest

sourceContracts: CompensationPlan: planId, originalReceiptRef, observedStateRef, supportedActionRefs, irreversibleOutcomes, requiredApprovalRef, expectedStateDigest, boundedDeadline. Every compensation is a new authorized journaled effect; plan cannot promise universal rollback or undo unknown external outcomes automatically.
rows.assertions: unknown/irreversible effects not silently undone; plan never dispatches compensation

sourceContracts: RecoveryInput: failedTaskRef, normalizedError, receiptRef?, currentPlanRef, attemptsAlreadyUsed. RecoveryPlan: retry/reconcile/replan/stop, reasonCode, approvedAlternativeRefs, nextPlanRevision?, maxRemainingAttempts. Unknown external effects select reconcile; retry cap includes previous attempts and excludes forbidden provider fallback.
rows.assertions: unknown external outcome => reconcile; attempts include previous; no privacy relaxation

sourceContracts: WorkerScore: workerId, metricVersion, sampleCount, quality/latency/cost/violation aggregates, evidenceRefs, measuredAt, validUntil. RankedWorker: workerId, eligibility, scoreBasis, deterministicRank. Eligibility (health/current grants/capacity/policy) precedes scoring; stale/poisoned samples cannot elevate unsafe workers.
rows.assertions: eligibility before score; reject stale/poisoned samples; deterministic ties

sourceContracts: CandidateComparisonRequest: goalRef, planRef, candidateRefs(2–4), evaluatorVersionRef, budgetRef, noLiveWrites=true. CandidateComparison: winnerRef|null, criterionResults, disagreementSummary, evidenceRefs, usage. Each candidate isolated; judge cannot authorize execution or exceed shared budget.
rows.assertions: 2..4 candidates; noLiveWrites=true; shared recorded usage <=budget; judge cannot authorize

sourceContracts: DebateRequest: proposalArtifactRef, roleRefs(2–4), maxRounds(1–2), successCriteriaRefs, budgetRef. DebateReport: proposalVersionRef, bounded contributions/evidenceRefs, disagreements, recommendations, usage. Two-round debate remains within inherited 8 delegated-task and 12 model-iteration caps.
rows.assertions: 2..4 roles/1..2 rounds; inherited8delegations/12iterations; preserve disagreement/evidence

sourceContracts: BudgetAllocationRequest: budgetRef, proposedWorkRefs, observedCostRefs, expectedVersion. BudgetAllocationPlan: version, allocations[{workRef,reservedTokens,reservedCostMicroUsd}], unknownUsageRefs, totalReserved. Reservation remains authoritative atomic budget service; optimization cannot exceed approved parent/tenant quotas.
rows.assertions: plan is advisory until atomic owner reservations; concurrent spend cannot exceed quota; integer overflow rejected

sourceContracts: ContextCompileRequest: permittedSourceRefs, goalRef?, taskType, maxContextTokens, stablePrefixRef, requiredToolGroupRefs. ContextBundle: ordered sourceRefs, compiledArtifactRef, prefixHash, tokenCount, omittedRefs/reasons, trustLabels. Preserve complete tool groups and inherited compression thresholds; measure retained-evidence recall.
rows.assertions: preserve complete tool groups/stable prefix; reject unauthorized source; exact token bound

sourceContracts: MemoryLifecycleRevision: memoryId, expectedMemoryVersion, sourceRefs, confidenceBasis, createdAt, verifiedAt?, expiresAt?, contradictionRefs, proposedValueRef?. Existing numeric confidence is preserved with a declared basis. Lifecycle metadata and value revisions use broker authorization/CAS; expired facts cannot outrank verified corrections.
rows.assertions: CAS; preserve numeric confidence; expired facts cannot outrank correction; role/private visibility

sourceContracts: MemoryBranchQuery: branchId, requestedScopeRefs, queryRef, expectedBranchVersion, limit(1–100). MemoryBranchResult: authorized branch ancestry, matching memoryRefs, versions, nextCursor?. Branch metadata defines parent/expiry/grants; inheritance never widens audience or copies Private facts into Global.
rows.assertions: same-tenant ancestry; deny audience widening/cycles/expired ancestry; no Private-to-Global copy

rows.table: credential_binding_metadata: opaque handles and target bindings only; no credential material
sourceContracts: CredentialHandleRequest: opaque handleId, verified effectRef, requiredAction/resource/audience, expiry and RunContext. CredentialResolution: opaque executionBindingRef, expiry, allowedTargetDigest. Resolution stays within trusted broker/executor; provider/DB/signing plaintext never reaches model, specialist task, UI or semantic memory.
rows.assertions: only opaque execution binding; forged target/expired/revoked handles rejected; no secret resolution in HTTP model

sourceContracts: ProjectRecord uses section 5. Restart preserves goal/plan/artifact/blocker refs and current revisions. Completion derives from required verified goals; renewed grants and per-run/project budget govern every resumed operation.
rows.assertions: completion requires current required goal verification; preserve canonical version field

sourceContracts: WorkspaceRequest: workspaceId, agentDefinitionRef, assignedPathRefs, readOnlyMountRefs, allowedDomains, byteQuota, expiresAt, retentionPolicyRef. WorkspaceLease: leaseId, opaque rootRef, validated mount/network profileDigest, expiry, cleanupState. Canonical path and symlink checks prevent escaping assigned roots.
rows.assertions: opaque canonical root; no escape/symlink widening; model cannot provision host filesystem

sourceContracts: ArtifactCandidate: artifactId, tenantId, owningConversationId/runId, mediaType, byteSize, contentRef, sha256, producerVersionRef, sourceEvidenceRefs, validationReportRef, visibilityScope. ArtifactReference remains the existing compatible reference; safe metadata supplies provenance. Publication/export is a separate authorized effect.
rows.assertions: registered digest matches trusted artifact-store bytes; metadata registration never publishes

sourceContracts: BrowserTask: taskId, goalRef, startingUrl, allowedDomainRefs, sessionProfileRef, permittedActionRefs, upload/downloadRefs, approvalRefs, deadline. Sensitive form submissions require exact policy approval; domain/redirect/file checks apply at execution; returns existing TaskResult evidence and artifacts.

DataTask: taskId, goalRef, connectionHandleRef, permittedSchemaRefs, queryArtifactRef, readOnly=true by default, row/byte/time limits, analysisCriteriaRefs. SQL parser/resource policy, real database runtime role and read limits precede execution. Output includes reproducible arithmetic and source/result digests; writes require a separate reviewed effect.

CodingTask: taskId, goalRef, repositoryRef, baseCommit, assignedPaths, allowedCommands, branchRef, acceptanceTestRefs, reviewPolicyRef. Branch/test/diff/PR stages are separate effects; no merge/deploy authority implied. Required independent review and scans attach evidence to existing TaskResult.

ResearchTask: taskId, goalRef, question, hypothesisRefs, permittedSourceRefs, maxQueries, claimCriteriaRefs, graphMode(disabled/scoped). Results use EvidenceClaim and VerificationReport, source timestamps, contradiction/unknown states. Persistent graph requires original 28 qualification; ordinary research does not silently enable it.
rows.assertions: browser/domain; data readOnly+row/byte/time; coding assignedPaths/baseCommit; research maxQueries/source bounds

sourceContracts: SecuritySignalBatch: tenantId, bounded metadata signalRefs(1–100), windowStart/end, detectorVersion. SecurityAlert: alertId, severity, observedAt, evidenceRefs, detectorVersion, signedReceiptRef, safeRecommendation. Monitor can observe/report only; it cannot grant permissions or edit protected policy.
rows.assertions: 1..100 safe signals; signed evidence; observation cannot mutate policy or self-grant

sourceContracts: UntrustedInput: inputRef, origin(web/tool/memory/episode/skill/remote), observedDigest, bounded contentRef. TrustLabelledInput: same refs/digest, instructionTrust(untrusted_data), flags, quarantineRef?. Detection false negatives never promote content to authorization; content cannot alter policy or credential scope.
rows.assertions: instructionTrust always untrusted_data; detector misses never raise authority

sourceContracts: DecisionSummary: decisionId, receiptRef/hash, action/target summaries, evidenceRefs, policyVersion, model/tool version refs, occurredAt, uncertainty, redactionVersion. Principal filtering precedes projection; no secrets, private chain-of-thought or raw provider prompts.
rows.assertions: verify receipt/hash and principal filter before safe projection; no raw prompt/chain of thought

sourceContracts: ReplayQuery: tenant-derived principal scope, runId, fromSequence/toSequence, limit(1–100), mode=read_only. ReplayView: ordered checkpoint/observation/result refs, recorded usage/timing, unknown outcomes, source digests. Replays recorded results only; never sends an original external operation again.
rows.assertions: read_only and1..100; ordered recorded refs; zero replayed external effects

sourceContracts: SimulationRequest: candidateVersionRef, scenarioSetRef, heldOutVersionRef, fixedBudgetRef, fixtureEnvironmentRef, noLiveEffects=true. SimulationReport: scenario/metric results, governance violations, usage, environmentDigest, input/candidate/eval digests, limitations. Candidate cannot write held-out cases or switch to real accounts.
rows.assertions: noLiveEffects=true; pinned inputs/evaluation/candidate; no real account effects

sourceContracts: AgentVersionManifest: versionId, prompt/config/model-policy/skills/tools/permission-policy/memory-policy/eval-set digests, compatibilityVersion, previousVersionRef?, signerRef. AgentVersionValidation: valid/rejected plus verifiedDigest and safe issues. A/B/canary/rollback is separately reviewed; signatures do not establish safety.
rows.assertions: all referenced digests pinned; append never deploys or updates held-out cases

sourceContracts: AgentReleaseRequest: candidateManifestRef, immutableEvalReportRefs, protectedBaselineDigest, gateVersion, targetEnvironmentRef, promotionApprovalRef. AgentReleaseReport: eligible/denied, independent gate evidence, signatures, canary/rollback plan refs. Evaluation does not itself deploy or promote.
rows.assertions: eligible/denied is evidence evaluation only; no deployment/promotion mutation

sourceContracts: ModelRoutingRequest: ModelRequest, taskClass, qualifiedCandidateModelRefs, scoringPolicyVersion, observedMetricRefs. ModelRoutingDecision: selectedModelRef|null, privacyEligibility evidence, scoreBasis, policyDecisionRef, budgetReservationRef, reason. Classify/authorize destination before cost/quality/latency scoring.
rows.assertions: privacy before scoring; no forbidden fallback; null selection permitted

sourceContracts: SwarmRequest: goalRef, planRef, reviewedAllocationRef, agentVersionRefs, requestedDepth≤2, requestedFanOut≤8, sharedBudgetRef. SwarmPlan: chief/lead/worker assignments, dependency refs, reducedGrantRequests, task/deadline limits. Request limits may be lowered by policy; larger background allocations require a distinct reviewed schedule/scope and never unrestricted peer grants.
rows.assertions: depth<=2/fanOut<=8; reduced grants; data model never dispatches swarm
